archetypes.label: Messaging / chat
archetypes.text: an app for sending and receiving chat messages with friends, like WhatsApp, Telegram or Signal

archetypes.label: Text messaging (SMS/MMS)
archetypes.text: the default text messaging app that reads, sends and stores SMS and MMS messages

archetypes.label: Phone dialer and contacts
archetypes.text: a phone app that places calls, shows contacts and call history

archetypes.label: Social media
archetypes.text: a social network app with posts, stories, photos and direct messages

archetypes.label: Email client
archetypes.text: an email app that sends and receives mail with attachments

archetypes.label: Web browser
archetypes.text: a web browser for visiting websites and downloading files

archetypes.label: Camera app
archetypes.text: a camera app that takes photos and records videos with location and microphones

archetypes.label: Photos and gallery
archetypes.text: a photo gallery or image editor that organises, edits and shares pictures

archetypes.label: Video player
archetypes.text: a video player that plays movie files from the device

archetypes.label: Music or podcast player
archetypes.text: a music or podcast app that plays audio in the background

archetypes.label: Maps and navigation
archetypes.text: a maps and navigation app that shows your position and gives directions

archetypes.label: Ride hailing or delivery
archetypes.text: a ride hailing app that shows nearby drivers, rides and calls the driver

archetypes.label: Shopping or food delivery
archetypes.text: an online shopping or food ordering app with deliveries to your address

archetypes.label: Banking
archetypes.text: a mobile banking app for accounts, transfers and card management with secure login

archetypes.label: Payments and wallet
archetypes.text: a payments app like a wallet or UPI app for sending money with QR codes and PIN

archetypes.label: Game
archetypes.text: a mobile game with levels, scores and in-app purchases

archetypes.label: Flashlight / torch
archetypes.text: a simple flashlight torch app that turns the LED light on and off with one button

archetypes.label: Calculator
archetypes.text: a basic calculator app for arithmetic, percentages and unit maths

archetypes.label: Wallpapers and themes
archetypes.text: a wallpaper app that sets pictures and themes as the home screen background

archetypes.label: Compass or spirit level
archetypes.text: a compass, spirit level or bubble level tool that uses device sensors

archetypes.label: Unit converter or utility tool
archetypes.text: a small utility tool that converts units or shows a ruler, timer or mirror

archetypes.label: Weather
archetypes.text: a weather app that shows forecasts and warnings for your current position

archetypes.label: News and reading
archetypes.text: a news app that shows articles, headlines and local stories

archetypes.label: Notes and to-do
archetypes.text: a notes or to-do app with text, voice memos and attached pictures

archetypes.label: Calendar
archetypes.text: a calendar app for events, reminders and invitations

archetypes.label: File manager
archetypes.text: a file manager that browses, copies and deletes files on the device

archetypes.label: Document scanner
archetypes.text: a document scanner that photographs pages, straightens them and exports PDF files

archetypes.label: QR or barcode scanner
archetypes.text: a QR code and barcode scanner that reads codes with the camera

archetypes.label: Keyboard or input method
archetypes.text: an on-screen keyboard that types text in other apps with themes and emoji

archetypes.label: Launcher / home screen
archetypes.text: a home screen launcher with widgets, app drawer, search and weather

archetypes.label: VPN or security tool
archetypes.text: a security app with antivirus scan, VPN tunnel and privacy protection

archetypes.label: Password manager or authenticator
archetypes.text: a password manager or authenticator app that fills logins and stores codes securely

archetypes.label: Fitness and health
archetypes.text: a fitness, step counter or health app that tracks workouts and routes

archetypes.label: Education or kids app
archetypes.text: an education app with lessons, videos, worksheets and quizzes for students

archetypes.label: Video or photo editor
archetypes.text: a video editing app with effects, music and exported clips

archetypes.label: Streaming video or TV
archetypes.text: a streaming app for movies, series and live TV channels

archetypes.label: Dating or social discovery
archetypes.text: a dating app with profiles, photos, chat and matching nearby people

archetypes.label: Government or identity services
archetypes.text: a government services app for identity documents, certificates and applications

archetypes.label: Remote control or smart home
archetypes.text: a remote control app for TVs, air conditioners and smart home devices

archetypes.label: Phone cleaner / optimizer
archetypes.text: a phone cleaner and booster app that frees storage, clears cache and saves battery

archetypes.label: Widget or system tool
archetypes.text: a small widget or system tool that shows clocks, battery status and quick settings

SPECIAL_ACCESS: an app that draws floating windows over other apps, such as chat heads or a screen recorder
an app that provides accessibility support for users with disabilities
an app that fills in passwords or one-time codes automatically
an app that reads notification history, such as a smartwatch companion
an employer device management or security suite that administers the phone
an app that installs other apps or updates itself directly
SMS: a messaging app that sends and receives text messages for the user
the default SMS app that manages text and picture messages
an app that backs up, restores or blocks spam text messages
an app that verifies your phone number by reading a one-time password from SMS
CONTACTS_CALL_LOGS: a phone or contacts app that shows your address book and call history
a messaging or social app that finds friends from your contacts
an app that lets you pick a person to call, pay or share something with
a dialer app that keeps a record of incoming and outgoing calls
CAMERA_MICROPHONE: a camera app that takes photos and records videos for the user
an app that makes video calls or voice calls
an app that records voice notes, audio or music
a scanner app that reads documents, QR codes or barcodes with the camera
an app that uses the microphone for speech recognition or voice commands
LOCATION: a maps or navigation app that shows your position and gives directions
a weather app that shows forecasts for where you are
a ride hailing or delivery app that shows things near you
a fitness app that tracks your runs and routes
an app that tags photos or posts with your location
PHONE_IDENTITY: an app that reads the device identity to detect SIM changes and prevent account fraud
a dialer app that places and manages phone calls
an app that manages your phone number, voicemail or call forwarding
an app that needs a stable device identifier for licensing, DRM or analytics
STORAGE_MEDIA: an app that edits, organises or shares photos and videos
a file manager or document app that browses files on the device
a music or video player that reads your media files
an app that saves downloads, exports or screenshots for the user
BACKGROUND_PERSISTENCE: a messaging or alarm app that must keep running to deliver notifications on time
an app that restarts automatically after the phone reboots
a music or podcast app that keeps playing audio in the background
an app that synchronises data periodically in the background
NETWORK: an app that connects to the internet to load content or synchronise data
an app that talks to a server for accounts, updates or cloud storage
an app that streams or downloads content from the internet
